invariants_acknowledged: Evidence comes only from production telemetry read by the collector; no hand-written, in-memory or simulated trace IDs or incidents (constitution, ADR-017, IFC-074 close rule).
The api request log goes through pino created lazily after the OTel SDK starts, so instrumentation-pino exports it over OTLP with trace_id/span_id.
The api log record never carries error.message, stack, cause, requestId, email or request input; path and errorName are allowlist-sanitised.
Committed evidence holds only allowlisted fields (hex ids, service, timestamps, numbers, rule uid/alertname, sanitised span names) and passes gitleaks with no new allowlist entry.
The collector is GET-only, reads GRAFANA_URL/GRAFANA_SA_TOKEN from env only, and never prints or writes the token, URL or response bodies.
MTTD KPI statistic is the mean of anchored incidents; met is reported as measured (true/false/null), never asserted.
The Sprint_plan row stays In Progress until a post-deploy collector run proves the api row (owner ruling 2026-10-22, option A).
